decision: R41 desktop project and final workspace closeout are CLOSED_PASS. Android hosted-CI hierarchy synchronization hardening is validated by direct CI #162 success. No further runtime or CI mutation is justified by current evidence.
exactNextAction: No action. Preserve baseline. Only create a successor revision for a new requirement/bug or externally provisioned trusted Windows signing identity.

trigger.head: 4f36b5c92da789be00d96388c8e1ffffe5e38fe8
trigger.observed: Android build, emulator boot, ADB, APK install and MainActivity launch all succeeded; the job failed immediately after the first UI Automator hierarchy pull because the expected fail-closed text was not yet present.

comparison.ci151: Different transient: adb device offline after deeper lifecycle progress; targeted retry passed.
comparison.ci160: ADB remained online and launch returned Status: ok; failure was a one-shot accessibility hierarchy assertion after launch.

rootCause.cause: The test assumed Activity launch completion implies immediate publication of the expected accessibility/UI hierarchy state.

methodEvidence.finding: am start -W waits for Activity launch completion.
UI tests should use bounded element/state waiting and explicit UI/app stability mechanisms rather than assume immediate hierarchy readiness.

prevention.change: Replace one-shot uiautomator dump assertions at lifecycle transitions with a bounded 15x1s dump_until_contains state wait.

ciHardening.adjudication: Bounded hierarchy-state synchronization is accepted as effective prevention for the CI #160 timing failure; root-cause classification remains PROBABLE_HIGH rather than overstated as proven.
